paper_title: First search for axion dark matter with a Madmax prototype
notes: First axion dark matter search with a dielectric haloscope prototype (MADMAX CB200). The paper reports 95% CL upper limits on axion-photon coupling |g_aγ| ≈ 2×10^-11 GeV^-1 in two mass ranges: 76.56–76.82 μeV (Configuration 1, centered at 76.72 μeV) and 79.31–79.53 μeV (Configuration 2, centered at 79.45 μeV). Data extracted from abstract and main text. The limit is mass-dependent across the narrow frequency ranges scanned; four representative points encode the two mass windows. Local axion DM density ρ_a = 0.3 GeV/cm³ assumed per abstract. No axion signal detected over 14.5 days of data collection. Systematic uncertainties on |g_aγ| range from 5% to 10% (Table I). The experiment uses a 1.6 T Morpurgo magnet at CERN with three sapphire disks and a mirror in a dielectric haloscope configuration. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.92, 4))
